name: refactor
author: lumine-code
description: Rename symbols across the project via provider-backed edits.
backgroundTips: You can rename the symbol under the cursor across the project with {{ 'refactor:rename' | keystroke }}

saveAfterEditInOpenBuffers.title: Save After Edit In Open Buffers
saveAfterEditInOpenBuffers.description: Save open buffers touched by a rename **if** they had no unrelated pending changes at the time of the rename. Files that were not open in the workspace are always saved.

offerUndoNotification.title: Offer Undo Notification
offerUndoNotification.description: Show a notification after a successful rename that lists the affected files and offers an Undo button.
